newsitem.title: GREECE: ALCO HELLAS SET FOR 2-FOR-10 BONUS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ALCO HELLAS SET FOR 2-FOR-10 BONUS ISSUE.

text.p: Small-cap aluminium firm Alco Hellas got shareholder approval for a two-for-10 bonus issue on Thursday, it said in a statement.
Alco Hellas will issue 601,072 bonus common bearer shares with a par value of 320 drachmas each, capitalising asset revaluation reserves amounting to 138 million shares, it said.
The firm will pay a dividend per share of 40 drachmas for fiscal 1996.
Alco Hellas saw its 1996 pretax profit increase 48 percent to 444 million drachmas on turnover growth of 19.4 percent to 3.72 billion drachmas.

Gross revenues increased to 1.11 billion drachmas in the first quarter of 1997 from 846 million drachmas in the same period a year earlier while pretax earnings grew to 146 million drachmas from 105 million in the first quarter of 1995.
Its shares lost 20 drachmas to close at 2,500 on Friday on thin volume. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
